title: Interaction ledger owner
source: Plan Appendix R §R3; TSD P3 v3; TSD P2 v3
description: The R-PREC default ruling and DP-18 give the interaction ledger to P1 rwb-source-data, but TSD P3 v3 defines the interaction table and the API Specification tags the case interaction endpoints x_module P3, and TSD P2 v3 defines efs_ledger_outcome. The ledger and its intake rule are placed with P1; P3 and P2 read it through P1's contract.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 15 P1 DB line; plan DP-18; API Specification v3 /cases/{caseId}/interactions x_module P3; TSD P3 v3 T3.1; TSD P2 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Case list row owner
source: Plan Appendix R §R3; TSD P1 v3; Architecture v5
description: TSD P1 v3 owns and builds case_list_row and reconciles it under JOB-04, while the R-PREC default ruling gives the case list API to P3. The row table is placed with P1 and the API and screen with P3.
evidence: TSD P1 v3 T3.1 (case_list_row NEW, re-keyed); FSD P1 v3 in scope; Architecture v5 slide 44 JOB-04
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Rule registry owner
source: Plan Appendix R §R3; TSD P4 v3; TSD P3 v3; Architecture v5
description: The default ruling, Architecture v5 slides 14, 27 and 41 and the Temporal and Drools design put the rule registry in P7 rwb-decision, but TSD P4 v3 defines rule_package, rule_package_version and rule_row and marks rule_test_case as owned by P4, and TSD P3 v3 carries the rule package admin APIs. Registry, rows and test cases are placed with P7; services evaluate a local copy only.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 14, 27 and 41; Temporal and Drools design slide 15; TSD P4 v3 T3.1; TSD P3 v3 T3.1 and appendix T-A (API-P3-020 to API-P3-026)
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: DoA table owner
source: Architecture v5; TSD P4 v3; Temporal and Drools design
description: Architecture v5 slides 14 and 41 put the DoA table in rwb_access and TSD P4 v3 defines delegation_limit, while the Drools design calls delegation limits versioned reference data, which the default ruling would place with P3. The DoA table is placed with P4; only non-DoA parameters and reference data stay with P3.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 14 (P4 DoA table; P7 REST Access DoA limits) and slide 41 P4; TSD P4 v3 T3.1; Temporal and Drools design (delegation limits as versioned reference data)
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: List of values owner
source: Plan Appendix R §R3; TSD P4 v3
description: The default ruling gives reference data (E1-043) to P3, but TSD P4 v3 lists lov_value in rwb_access. lov_value is placed with P3 as reference data; P4 keeps only role, scope, masking and DoA tables.
evidence: Plan Appendix R §R3 default ruling and DP-07; TSD P4 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Partner user owner
description: Architecture v5 slide 41 gives partner users to S9 rwb-partner, but TSD P4 v3 defines partner_user in rwb_access. The table is placed with S9; P4 keeps the internal role model only.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 41 S9 (partner users) and slide 17 S9 DB line; TSD P4 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Feature flag owner
source: Plan Appendix R §R3; TSD P2 v3
description: The default ruling gives feature flags to the platform library (PLT), but TSD P2 v3 defines feature_flag and feature_flag_change and the API Specification tags the feature-flag endpoints x_module P2. The tables are placed with PLT; P2 serves the admin API against the library.
evidence: Plan Appendix R §R3 default ruling; TSD P2 v3 T3.1; API Specification v3 /feature-flags and /admin/feature-flags x_module P2
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Outbox, inbox and idempotency table owner
source: Architecture v5; TSD P2 v3; Plan DP-09
description: Architecture v5 slide 20 gives every service its own outbox and inbox and DP-09 puts them in the RWB-PLT-TE006 library, but TSD P2 v3 lists outbox_event, outbox_delivery, processed_event and idempotency_key in rwb_integration. PLT owns the library tables and each service creates its own copy through the template.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 11 and 20; plan DP-09; TSD P2 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Job catalogue owner
source: TSD P2 v3; API Specification v3; Architecture v5
description: TSD P2 v3 defines job_catalog and /admin/scheduled-jobs is x_module P2, but /admin/jobs and its rerun are x_module P1 and Architecture v5 slide 44 retires the shared Quartz job table in favour of Temporal Schedules owned by each service. The register is placed with P2.
evidence: TSD P2 v3 T3.1; API Specification v3 /admin/jobs (P1) and /admin/scheduled-jobs (P2); Architecture v5 slide 44
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Retention rule owner
description: Architecture v5 slides 16, 41 and 44 (JOB-17) place retention in rwb-document, but TSD P1 v3 keeps retention_rule in rwb_source_data. The rule and the monthly job are placed with P5; P1 drops its copy.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 16, 41 and 44 JOB-17; TSD P1 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Signature request owner
description: Architecture v5 slides 16 and 41 put signatures in rwb_document, but TSD P6 v3 defines signature_request in rwb_comms. The table is placed with P5; P6 orchestrates the request through P5's contract.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 16 and 41 P5 (signatures); TSD P6 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Timer table versus durable timers
source: Architecture v5; Physical Schema v6; TSD P3 v3
description: The Physical Schema and TSD P3 keep a scanned timer table, while Architecture v5 slides 25, 42 and 44 retire TimerDue and JOB-05 and run the clocks as durable Temporal timers. The timer table is kept with P3 as the screen projection; the clock moves into CaseWorkflow.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 25, 42 (TimerDue retired) and 44 (JOB-05 retired); Physical Schema v6 timer; TSD P3 v3 T3.1; API Specification v3 GET /cases/{caseId}/timers
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Data lake watermark owner
source: Architecture v5; Physical Schema v6; TSD P1 v3
description: The Physical Schema and TSD P1 v3 keep lake_copy_watermark and a lake copy for JOB-13, while Architecture v5 slide 37 and DP-17 remove the data lake and slide 44 makes JOB-13 continuous Kafka ingest in rwb-decision. The table is recorded as a P1 legacy table with no target.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 37 and 44; plan DP-17; Physical Schema v6 lake_copy_watermark; TSD P1 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: DP04 copy owner
description: Architecture v5 slides 18 and 41 make S2 and S3 the owners of treatments and guarantee claims, while TSD P1 v3 keeps the dated DP04 copies dp_treatment and dp_guarantee_claim in rwb_source_data. The live records stay with S2 and S3, the dated copies with P1.
evidence: Architecture v5 slides 18 and 41; TSD P1 v3 T3.1
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop

title: Writer of the appraisal extension
description: FSD P1 v3 owns valuation_ext as one of the four extension tables but its open question OQ-P1-05 leaves open who writes stale_flag and age_days, P1 or S1, and Architecture v5 slide 41 gives valuations to S1. The extension row is placed with P1 and S1 keeps the route decision in rwb_valuation.
evidence: FSD P1 v3 change note, OQ-P1-05 and A2.6; TSD P1 v3 T3.1; Architecture v5 slide 41 S1 (valuations)
proposed: Adopt the owner recorded in the Ownership Map part tables and confirm in the verification loop
